item.title: Combiner 0.11.0
item.description:
• A new look: blued steel, slate panels and steel-blue choices, the same Cold Steel as the plug-ins and REF.
  • A steel app icon to match.
  • Cards explain things in plain sentences; labels and buttons stay in capitals.
  • ⚙︎ › Look sets how worn the steel looks: Clean, Brushed or Gritty.
  • An idle Combiner no longer redraws its window every 15 seconds.
